feeds.title: Sophie's Floorboard
feeds.description: This is a place you can find some links to known and unknown emo bands and albums, old and new. Consider it like a search engine, with old, classic albums and new ones worth a listen.

feeds.title: Open Mind / Saturated Brain
feeds.description: This blog will focus primarily on my most beloved genres of music - rock. From atmospheric acoustic bands to screaming banshee devil worshippers - all of it will be covered here. The purpose of this blog, besides exposing/reviewing new releases and bands in general, will be to further build and support independent, awesome music and great people in a positive and open community. There will be questions answered, tours posted, relevant and interesting news, mp3s, live videos and my inane ramblings.

feeds.title: Drifting with the ice Blog
feeds.description: A blog for all things that are emo or emo-adjacent. Know more about emo bands, new music, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Washed Up Emo
feeds.description: A website dedicated to the late 90s and early 2000s emo, post-hardcore and punk scene. The home for the Washed Up Emo Podcast and Emo Night NYC. As the site and scene have evolved, it's become more of an archive and history/curatorial place for emo as a whole, regardless of your preference of the waves.

feeds.title: The Hard Times » Emo-Screamo
feeds.description: Stay up tp date with all the latest emo music news, artists, bands, albums and more! The Hard Times is a very real punk news site that you should not question. The historic satire site was founded in December 1976. It's made by a group of punk and hardcore kids from all the different sub-genres of the DIY hardcore scene.

feeds.title: Grandma Sophia's Cookies » Emo
feeds.description: Posts about emo written by yngharlem, Grandma Sophia, and Hang Ten Higgins. Grandma Sophia's Cookies is an independently run music and culture blog based out of Manhattan, NY.

feeds.title: Wilfully Obscure
feeds.description: Wilfully Obscure is a long-running indie music blog by 'spavid' that spotlights lesser-known power pop, punk, emo, shoegaze, and indie rock offering rare album reissues, live bootlegs, demo tapes, and deep-curated mixes with thoughtful write‑ups.

feeds.title: Distorted Sound Magazine » Emo
feeds.description: Distorted Sound Magazine is your number one spot for news, reviews, interviews, articles and opinions about the world of rock, metal, hardcore and all facets of heavy music!

feeds.title: This Endless Breath
feeds.description: This blog is pretty much just going to be some possibly lesser-known or hard-to-find North American 2000-era emo, screamo, skram, blah blah, whatever you want to call it.

feeds.title: Miss The Stars
feeds.description: Explore the Miss The Stars blog for screamo/emo-violence & relatives since 2009.

feeds.title: Louder Than War » Emo Music Reviews
feeds.description: Read The Latest Emo Reviews From The Writers & Contributors at Louder Than War.

feeds.title: mySoundposter.blog » Emo
feeds.description: This blog, created by computer scientist and amateur musician Urs Lerch, aims to support independent artists by helping them be heard and seen, while also collecting and preserving the cultural context of music. Inspired by his time living in New York and Barcelona, it reflects his dual passion for technology and music.

feeds.title: Independent Music Reviews » Emo
feeds.description: Resource for people by Inspired Independent artists and inspiring albums. Independent Music Reviews is a music blog that contains album reviews, music news, new releases, just released singles and videos. They attempt to review most of the albums on the site.
